statement: Implement Q4 bounded structured partials across a single canonical finite-JSON partial codec owner, the distributed-operation authoring and service source/entry/typings contracts, Call Cell routing normalization, Call Cell invoker, and Call Cell reduce coordinator so shards emit bounded structured finite-JSON contributions under runtime-owned delivery identities, duplicate application group keys across or within shards are preserved without host-side group merging or numeric truncation, identical delivery replays are idempotent no-ops, conflicting or stale delivery replays fail closed with typed REDUCE_INCOMPLETE reasons, and reducers receive the complete validated contribution sequence in deterministic (shardId, emissionOrdinal) order.
